test_GrowPruneTreeProposer_select_leaf_t: test the GrowPruneTreeProposer select_leaf_to_grow method to pick the best leaf node to grow
test_GrowPruneTreeProposer_select_split_: test the GrowPruneTreeProposer select_split_node_to_prune method to pick a split node for pruning
test_GrowPruneTreeProposer_get_new_mutat: test the GrowPruneTreeProposer get_new_mutation method to decide between grow or prune mutations
test_GrowPruneTreeProposer_select_grow_d: test the GrowPruneTreeProposer select_grow_dim method to choose which dimension to split on
